title: genista nigricans
intro: Genista nigricans, commonly known as Blackthorn or Black Broom, is a shrub-like plant belonging to the pea family (Fabaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Genista nigricans are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, improve circulation, and exhibit antispasmodic and sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
